text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The summit seems close, yet so far. If I do not accept this reality, I will be swallowed by eternal recurrence.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...We are challengers.
A strong individual transmutes wax into gold,
ascending to the heavens."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, victory and defeat are neither fate nor prophecy!
Sever causality with your own power!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I shall remain an insatiable seeker!
I'll hone my aesthetics and elevate them into inevitability!!"
choice_data_list: That was another great run in today's race.
It's a steep road ahead, but let's overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I gained something from this conflict as well.
Through that lesson,
my individuality is forged.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I shall circulate this nourishment through flesh and blood, and climb to the pinnacle!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'll drink it down... this scorching ordeal.
Otherwise, I wouldn't be me!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Qualia carved into flesh and bone! I will become even stronger!
GAHAHAHAHA!!
